environment.description: Flask application deployed on EC2 behind an Application Load Balancer with no WAF attached. The ALB forwards all HTTP traffic directly to the Flask application on port 8080. Security groups allow inbound 443 from 0.0.0.0/0 to ALB and ALB to EC2 on 8080. No request filtering or inspection is performed at any layer.

config.network: Public ALB, no CloudFront, no additional proxy layers
